clue.text: One's not well placed here

parts.note: read as a place where someone who is unwell is put to lie and recover, not a badly positioned thing

explanation.definitionFit: A room set aside for a patient is exactly where a person who is not well is put.

clue.text: Sequence of programs left in connecting part of computer

parts.note: a serial is a run of linked broadcasts, a story told episode by episode
port is the left-hand side of a ship

explanation.surface: A technical manual describes a run of software stored in a computer's connector.
explanation.definitionFit: This socket is a computer interface that sends data one bit at a time to attached devices.

clue.text: Technical discipline supports study in ethical awareness

indicators.note: in a down clue the second piece sits beneath and so holds up the first one

parts.note: to con is an old verb meaning to study or learn by heart
science is a technical branch of learning

explanation.surface: Engineering students take a course in ethics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supports' puts SCIENCE under CON in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Conscience is the moral sense that tells right from wrong.

clue.text: Gum adheres initially though not entirely

indicators.note: though not entirely says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Chewing gum sticks at first but then comes loose.
explanation.definitionFit: Resin is a sticky plant exudate, and gum is the name for such sap.

clue.text: Mitre, perhaps, indicating high award

parts.note: the five letters of the word mitre are one possible ordering, or arrangement, of the letters spelling merit

explanation.surface: A bishop's headgear is a sign of an honour bestowed on him.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse clue: MITRE is one 'order of MERIT', an arrangement of those letters, and 'perhaps' signals it is one example.
explanation.definitionFit: The Order of Merit is an exclusive British honour given by the monarch for distinguished service.

clue.text: Newspaperman I'd encountered in memory, when recalled

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the built word is read in reverse
the contraction is met inside the memory word, so it is placed within it

parts.note: rote is learning by memory, as in 'by rote'
the contraction I'd gives the letters ID

explanation.surface: A journalist recalls a meeting that sticks in his mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'encountered in' signals the container and 'when recalled' reverses the whole result; 'by rote' is the idiom that links rote to memory.
explanation.definitionFit: An editor runs a newspaper, so is a newspaper man in a senior role.

clue.text: Ready with novelty act? That's the ticket!

indicators.note: novelty means something new, so the letters of the preceding word are made new by rearranging

parts.note: a turn is a performer's act on a variety bill

explanation.surface: A performer with a fresh routine is pleased to hear it is just what is wanted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novelty' rearranges READY into DAYRE. 'That's the ticket' looks like an exclamation of approval, but the definition is a literal ticket.
explanation.definitionFit: A day return is a rail fare for going out and coming back on the same date.

clue.text: Myrtle's age is given away by this!

definitions.text: Myrtle's age is given away by this!

parts.words: Myrtle's age is given away by this!
parts.note: Myrtle reads as a woman's name with a secret age, but a myrtle is a shrub or small ... whose growth layers count its years

explanation.definitionFit: Each annual growth band in a trunk marks one year, so counting them reveals how old a woody plant is.

clue.text: See 7
Call team to appear in sporting location

parts.note: to ring is to call on the telephone
a side is a team in sport

explanation.surface: A coach phones the players to tell them to turn up at the stadium.
explanation.walkthrough: RINGSIDE is the area next to a boxing ring.
explanation.definitionFit: The seats beside the boxing arena are a place where sport is watched close up.

clue.text: Ancient monster, very rampageous between West and North

indicators.note: the rearranged letters sit between the two compass points, inside them
rampaging wildly, so the letters of the word beside it run riot

explanation.surface: An old beast runs amok across the land from the west to the north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rampageous' is the anagram signal and 'between' the container; a wyvern appears often in heraldry as a winged beast.
explanation.definitionFit: A wyvern is a two-legged winged dragon of heraldry and legend.

clue.text: Various answers I list family members supplied

indicators.note: various suggests a mixture, so the letters of the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone lists different responses supplied by relatives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Various' rearranges the twelve letters of ANSWERS I LIST.
explanation.definitionFit: A spouse's female siblings, or a sibling's wives, are relatives by marriage.

clue.text: Not agreeing with the French?

parts.note: read as disagreeing, said in the French language rather than disagreeing with French people

explanation.definitionFit: This French phrase means 'on the contrary', used to contradict what was just said.

clue.text: Asset with mice scurrying round one?

definitions.text: Asset with mice scurrying round one?

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go round the single letter, enclosing it
scurrying means rushing about, so the letters of the words before it are jumbled

parts.note: A is the indefinite article, meaning one

explanation.surface: A pet that has mice running around it would be useful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scurrying' signals the anagram and 'round' the container; the whole clue also describes the cat, prized for chasing mice.
explanation.definitionFit: A Siamese is a breed of domestic feline with blue eyes and dark points, a pet that catches rodents.

clue.text: Nurse working with it is producing inflammation

parts.note: to tend is to nurse or look after
on means working, as a switched-on machine

explanation.surface: A nurse on duty says this is what is causing the swelling.
explanation.definitionFit: This condition is swelling and irritation of the cord joining muscle to bone.

clue.text: Papers quickly 'outing former lover

indicators.note: outing means putting out, so the former partner's letters are removed

parts.note: express means fast, as in express delivery
an ex is a former partner

explanation.surface: Newspapers rush to expose a celebrity's former partner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outing' takes EX out of EXPRESS. 'Papers' collectively are the press, the newspapers.
explanation.definitionFit: The press is the collective name for newspapers and journalists.

clue.text: Lumbering old beast — source of several stampeding outrages

indicators.note: the source of a word is where it begins, its first letter
stampeding means rushing in a disorderly herd, so the letters of the word after it are jumbled

explanation.surface: A heavy animal on the rampage is behind several outrages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'source of' takes S from 'several'; 'stampeding' rearranges OUTRAGES into TEGOSAUR.
explanation.definitionFit: A plated dinosaur is an extinct, slow-moving creature from prehistoric times.

clue.text: Festival includes chunk of meat served over in pasta

indicators.note: the festival word contains the other pieces within it

parts.note: a fete is a festival or outdoor fair

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the meat word is read backwards

parts.note: a cut is a piece of meat from the butcher

explanation.surface: A summer fair features a piece of meat served on a bed of pasta.
explanation.walkthrough: 'served over' reverses the meat word and 'includes' places it, with IN, inside the fair; 'in' looks like a link word but gives letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Fettucine is a form of ribbon noodles, flat strips of egg dough.

clue.text: Criminal peer stripped of power after row

indicators.note: the trimmed piece comes after the noise word

parts.note: a racket is a noisy row or din

indicators.note: stripped of means having something taken away, so a letter is removed

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for power in physics

explanation.surface: A lord loses his authority following a quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stripped of' signals the deletion and 'after' orders the charade; 'peer' looks like the criminal's victim but only supplies letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A racketeer is someone who makes money by fraud or extortion, a gangster.

clue.text: Traveller's agreement taking mother in

indicators.note: the agreement sign takes the parent inside itself
in confirms the parent word goes inside the agreement word

parts.note: a nod is a sign of agreement
ma is a familiar word for mother

explanation.surface: A traveller agrees to give his mother a lift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking ... in' puts MA inside NOD. The 's after 'Traveller' stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A nomad is a wanderer who moves from place to place with no fixed home.

clue.text: It's the first mistake as a religious concept

parts.note: original means the first of its kind
a sin is a wrong act or error

explanation.surface: Theologians explain that the first wrongdoing is treated as a doctrine.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface itself describes the doctrine: Adam's first wrongdoing as an inherited fault.
explanation.definitionFit: In Christian doctrine, humanity's inherited state of wrongdoing stems from Adam's fall.

clue.text: Help one surrounded by rising molten rock

indicators.note: the numeral sits inside the reversed rock word
in a down clue rising means read upwards, so the rock word is reversed

parts.note: lava is molten rock from a volcano
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A climber calls for help, caught by lava welling up around him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns LAVA into AVAL in this down entry, and 'surrounded by' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Avail as a noun means use or benefit, as in 'to no avail'.

clue.text: Leave women to take in a network TV programme

indicators.note: take in means hold within, so the other pieces go inside

parts.note: to go is to leave
a mesh is a net or network of threads

explanation.surface: Women are told to leave and pick up a broadcasting network.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to take in' signals the container: the a-plus-net pieces sit inside the departure word followed by the women abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: A game show is a television entertainment where contestants compete for prizes.

clue.text: See 22
Retreat centre remains allocated to male

parts.note: ash is what remains after burning
a ram is a male sheep

explanation.surface: A retreat leaves its leftover funds to a man.
explanation.definitionFit: An ashram is a Hindu hermitage where people go for spiritual withdrawal.

clue.text: Get over injury, without a doubt

parts.note: to clear is to get over an obstacle, as a hurdle
a cut is a wound or injury

explanation.surface: A patient recovers from a wound, there is no question.
explanation.definitionFit: Something clear-cut is plain and definite, leaving no uncertainty.

clue.text: Recalled attraction of French king

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the pieces are read backwards

parts.note: a draw is something that attracts crowds
de is French for of

explanation.surface: A French monarch's appeal is remembered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Recalled' turns DRAW plus DE into EDWARD.
explanation.definitionFit: Edward is the name of several English monarchs.

clue.text: Contributions of centuries to MCC total

definitions.text: Contributions of centuries to MCC total

parts.words: Contributions of centuries to MCC total
parts.note: reads as cricket hundreds for the Marylebone Cricket Club, but MCC is the Roman numeral 1200 and each century, C, is 100 of it

explanation.walkthrough: MCC is the Marylebone Cricket Club, which governs cricket's laws; a century is 100 runs.
explanation.definitionFit: Each C is 100, and 100 is one share of 1200 split into twelve equal parts.
